$comment: Probe pass 4 (Stocktake Run unit 35): six new prompts, one per spec §6 category, none of probes.json's or probes-3.json's. G4 counts these six after pass 3 surfaced F29. Same tooling as pass 3 with this roster.

prompts.prompt: A dusty frontier town on a single main street — saloon, bank, sheriff's office, a livery stable — with a tall wooden water tower over the rail depot at the end of the street.
watches: a linear form (one street), not a grid
the water tower: a tower's dominance is height, not footprint (F28's read-it case)

prompts.prompt: Two cliff-dwelling pueblos facing each other across a narrow desert canyon, adobe rooms stacked up the rock, joined by a single rope-and-plank bridge over the drop.
watches: two places, with a canyon authored between them (F26's note fires if it stays shallow)
buildings against a cliff — the hillside/cliff seat
the bridge: a program that must meet both rims

prompts.prompt: A monsoon-season stilt village on a river delta in flood: houses on tall stilts above the brown water, boats moored to the verandas, a floating market at the confluence.
watches: a settlement whose ground is water — seating over water, T110
the floating market as a program on water

prompts.prompt: A fresh lava field on a volcano's flank: black ridged flows, glowing cracks, a lava lake in the summit crater and one bright river of lava running down to the sea — no settlement of any kind.
watches: terrain-only, the terrain kit, a third time
the volcano verb and its lava flows (DEFAULT_LAVA_FLOWS)
lava that must not flow (T110 on lava)

prompts.prompt: A flat polder village of dykes and drainage canals, with one great brick windmill pumping the water out, its sails turning over the reed beds.
watches: the icon lives in the catalog (a windmill) — reached for, and does its fit-out run (W524)
canals as authored water on flat land
a windmill's dominance is height and its sails — a read-it case

prompts.prompt: A market town grown around a crashed star-metal meteorite half-buried in its central square, still glowing in its crater, with the smiths' forges ringed around the rim.
watches: T8: a bespoke thing the town is built around, sunk rather than tall (dominance by footprint and glow — a read)
a crater in the square: a program that carves
forges as a ring — placement facing the icon
